verdict.rationale: Token2's docs say browsers prompt users to set a PIN on its FIDO keys. Its official tooling manages that PIN (set, change, minimum PIN length) and handles PIN changes and resets. The fido2-manage tool also lists, enrolls and deletes biometric templates, so on-device user verification is clearly supported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that user verification is enforced so a stolen key cannot authenticate, confirmation of which Token2 key models have built-in biometric sensors (the bio tooling is manufacturer-agnostic), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
